growth_signal.value: Serves 23 markets with clients including Vodafone and Glovo, plus a pilot with Deutsche Telekom; one hotel client reported a 22% increase in direct bookings after deploying its agents.

raised.value: €22M ($26M) Series A led by Creandum, with Elaia and Speedinvest, bringing total funding to €25M ($30M)

entry.idea: GetVocal builds AI agents that handle customer support, sales and lead qualification calls and chats for large companies, stepping in for human agents on routine conversations.
entry.lesson: Building trust and auditability into an AI product from the start can be the deciding factor for winning regulated, risk-averse enterprise customers.
entry.name: GetVocal AI

growth.reason: It operates in 23 markets with named enterprise clients and a documented 22% increase in bookings for one customer, real and verifiable traction.

market.reason: Automating customer support and sales conversations is a large market shared by enterprises across many industries worldwide.

tech.reason: Its governance layer, keeping every AI decision traceable and human-overridable in real time, is solid applied AI engineering built specifically for regulated environments.

sources.title: AI customer support agent startup GetVocal raises $26M - Tech.eu
Backed with €22 million, French startup GetVocal expands its hybrid AI built for the 5% that actually works | EU-Startups
Governed AI agents for enterprise CX | GetVocal

entry.twist: Its 'Control Tower' keeps a human supervisor able to approve, override or take over any AI conversation in real time, giving regulated industries the audit trail and control they need to trust automated agents.
entry.who_pays: Large enterprises and outsourced customer service providers, including telecoms and hospitality brands, pay to deploy GetVocal's AI agents across their support and sales channels.
entry.why_now: Companies want to cut the cost of large call and chat support teams using AI, but regulations like the EU AI Act and industry compliance needs mean they need proof of control and traceability before they will deploy AI agents at scale.
